regime_context: The detector shows an absolute-trend-gated, broad (50% eligible) rotation where Oil & Gas Producers dominate as the crowded leader, with Big Banks a distant but trend-durable challenger. Gate_helps is true, so the trend discipline has historically cut drawdown, but the momentum rank is only a focus lens (rank-IC ~0), and the state's own track record shows 31.9% directional accuracy — calls here should be conditionals, not forecasts.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Pipelines & Midstream (unscorable proxy, but breadth=1.0 and durability_bar=0.77, the highest trend-health read in the ranks) turns into a confirmed leadership handoff from Oil & Gas. The watch retires if Oil & Gas Producers hold the rank-1 momentum slot AND breadth above 0.8 through two consecutive detector prints.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks rank second with an eligible trend, the strongest durability bar in the top ranks (0.71), a 'trend' hurst tag, and non-crowded positioning — a cleaner trend-continuation case than the crowded, mixed-hurst oil leader. The absolute-trend gate (the one validated leg) is satisfied, so staying-power risk is moderated by the discipline rather than by momentum.
evidence: rotation margin to challenger is large (1.393), but banks are the confirmed challenger, not a predicted handoff
theses.dissent: The gap to Oil & Gas is wide (2.24 vs 0.847), and the detector's rotation timing leg has no validated forward edge; the strong durability bar may simply reflect a long-running mean-reverting financials tape that underperforms choppy energy on any oil upleg.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags the S&P/TSX by 3% over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners score moderately (0.29, rank 5) but are ineligible under the absolute-trend gate with a very weak durability bar (0.14) and zero breadth (0.0). The gate is the only validated edge, and this theme fails it, so there is no staying-power support — the lean is to not allocate here, not a short.
evidence: hurst_tag='mixed' with near-zero breadth signals a broken trend
theses.dissent: Precious metals can gap on macro or geopolitical surprise, and the macro narrative shows elevated unscheduled-share (1.0) with geopolitics in the mix; a gold spike would invalidate the avoidance without the detector's rank having predicted it.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO becomes eligible (absolute-trend gate) and closes 3% higher than the benchmark by 20 trading days
